subject: SIG request: vulnerability tempo summary and remediation attestation
messages:
From: Hannah Reed <h.reed@sig.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: John Patel <j.patel@fintrust.com>, security@acme.example
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: request for vulnerability tempo & remediation attestation

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the time on the call yesterday. As part of the SIG questionnaire validation we need a concise summary showing:

- Scan cadence (unauthenticated quick scans, weekly; authenticated scans, monthly; penetration testing cadence)
- SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (what you treat as Critical/High/Medium/Low and target windows)
- Evidence mapping for the last 12 months (scan indexes, remediation tickets, patch timestamps)
- Any exceptions or compensating controls for missed SLAs

Can you provide a short attestation (signed PDF or email with named approver) that the above is accurate for the environment serving AcmeCorp, plus attachments with the scan index and a mapping file that links CVE IDs -> internal ticket -> mitigation/closure date? If there are SOC 2/CAIQ references you think are relevant, please flag them.

We'd like this by EOD Friday (2025-06-13) to keep the SIG review on schedule.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Reed
SIG Assessment Team

[Note: request refers to control mappings for CAIQ-V2 and SIG domain Vulnerability Management]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Reed <h.reed@sig.org>, John Patel <j.patel@fintrust.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG follow-up: request for vulnerability tempo & remediation attestation

Ben / Kim — please see Hannah's request from SIG. Acme is in-scope for this review; we need a short attestation and the evidence bundle. Key asks:

- Attestation signed by security leadership (we usually have Ben or Kim sign)
- CSV mapping: CVE -> JIRA ticket -> mitigation steps -> closure timestamp
- Scan index: weekly quick scans for last 12 months, monthly authenticated scan run results, and PT summaries where applicable
- Note any exceptions (e.g., two outstanding low-risk backports with compensating controls)

Ben: can you draft the attestation language and confirm SLAs below so I can send to SIG? I suggest we cite our internal remediation windows rather than the generic ones: Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days, Low = next scheduled minor release.

Kim: please pull the scan index export from Drive (folder: scan-archives/2025/Q2) and the mapping CSV. If you want, attach the redwood_weekly_scan_index_202505-202506.csv and authenticated-scan-summary-may2025.zip.

Thanks — we need this on Hannah's timeline.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Reed <h.reed@sig.org>, John Patel <j.patel@fintrust.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for vulnerability tempo & remediation attestation

Evelyn / Kim — drafting the attestation below and attaching the mapping. Attachment stubs: cve_remediation_assertion_20250612.pdf (attestation), redwood_weekly_scan_index_202505-202506.csv (index), authenticated-scan-summary-may2025.zip (scan artifacts).

Draft attestation (let me know edits):

---
Redwood Inference vulnerability tempo and remediation attestation (AcmeCorp environment)

Redwood Inference attests that, for systems covering the AcmeCorp production environment, the following production vulnerability management cadence and remediation SLAs are maintained:
- Scan cadence: unauthenticated discovery scans — weekly; authenticated credentialed scans — monthly; scheduled penetration testing — annually or upon major architecture change.
- Remediation SLAs: Critical (RCE/privilege escalation/factory resetable) — target remediation within 7 calendar days; High (critical data exposure or privilege elevation vectors) — target 30 calendar days; Medium — 90 calendar days; Low — addressed in next minor release or tracked backlog.
- Evidence package: attached CSV maps detected CVEs to internal ticket IDs and closure timestamps; weekly index contains scan job IDs and output checksums.
- Exceptions: two low-severity third-party library backports are deferred due to functional risk; compensating controls include WAF rule and runtime monitor. These are documented in tickets RED-3492 and RED-3591 with planned completion by 2025-07-15.

We confirm this attestation is accurate as of 2025-06-12 and is signed by Redwood security leadership.

---

Kim — once you confirm attachments are correct I will sign and return the PDF. If Hannah needs CAIQ or SOC 2 control references, we can add a short appendix mapping our cadence/SLA to CAIQ-V2 controls VM-1 / VM-2 and SOC 2 CC (Risk Assessment and Change Management tie-ins).

Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: cve_remediation_assertion_20250612.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Reed <h.reed@sig.org>, John Patel <j.patel@fintrust.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for vulnerability tempo & remediation attestation

Hi Hannah — attaching the requested material and providing the formal attestation below. Apologies for the late hour; we validated the CSV against our ticketing system and exported signed artifacts.

Formal attestation (signed):

Redwood Inference attests that the vulnerability management cadence and remediation SLAs as summarized by Ben Carter are correct for the AcmeCorp-scoped environment. For the 12-month lookback period ending 2025-06-12:
- Critical CVEs: 100% closed within 7 calendar days with no open criticals at time of attestation.
- High CVEs: 96% closed within 30 calendar days; remaining high issues are documented with remediation plans and compensating monitoring.
- Medium/Low: tracked per policy and remediated per 90-day and release windows respectively.

Exceptions: two deferred backports (tickets RED-3492, RED-3591) for low-severity third-party components; compensating controls applied as described in the attached ticket exports.

Signed,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: redwood_weekly_scan_index_202505-202506.csv; authenticated-scan-summary-may2025.zip; cve_remediation_assertion_20250612.pdf

Please confirm receipt and let us know if SIG needs a separate CAIQ appendix.

Thanks,
Kim
